dcterms:description: The Stanford Sentiment TreeBank (SST) is a dataset for sentiment analysis, where each constituent node in a phrase-structured tree is manually assigned an integer sentiment polarity from 0 to 4, representing five sentiment classes: very negative, negative, neutral, positive, and very positive.
dcterms:title: Stanford Sentiment TreeBank
